rule: Several frames (four L-shaped corner brackets of one colour, arm 2 or 3) each enclose one 8-connected single-colour shape whose bounding box lies exactly 2 cells inside the frame. Exactly one shape has its frame's colour. The output is that shape's bounding box, cropped from the input with the background kept. Equivalently, the target is the unique component whose bbox grown by 2 has four own-colour corners.
scope: Construct independently positioned corner-bracket frames and 8-connected monochrome shapes. Crop the unique shape matching its own frame colour. Variable palettes, repeated frame colours, decoys, arm lengths 2/3, shape dimensions and 2..8 frames; default canvases favour canonical 30x30.
constraints: Five original pairs exact; 1000 independent seeds all distinct and solver-exact
Independent input-only component/corner interpreter verifies 1792 distinct cases, including 600 feasible dimension controls, 140 partial frame-count controls and 52 extreme shape/arm combinations
Default cases include 725 cross-frame colour decoys, 806 repeated frame colours, 240 all-same frame colours and 384 diagonally connected shapes
Six invalid controls rejected; requested frame counts 2..8 honoured
known_limitations: All shapes within an example share dimensions and bracket arm length, matching canonical scope
Frames are separated by a background gap; background must be strictly most frequent
Non-30x30 canvases and explicit extreme shape/count controls are synthetic extensions; requested scene must fit two frames
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback

authored_scope: Sampled: background colour, arm length (2/3), shared shape size (2..5 per side; 1 and 6 only when requested), frame count (3..6 by default, 2..8 when requested), free or jittered-lattice layouts, and frame/shape colours. Frame colours can be repeated or all identical, and decoy shapes take other frames' colours. Grid size is 30x30 in 70% of fully unspecified calls. Otherwise it is drawn from feasible sizes in 16..30, a synthetic extension. Explicit replay of frame lists reconstructs the fixtures. Not supported: multi-colour shapes, shapes of different sizes within one grid, nested or touching frames, noise.
authored_constraints: Frames are separated by at least one background row or column, so no cross-frame 8-adjacency.
Shape cells sit 2 cells inside their frame and never touch their own brackets.
Exactly one frame has frame_colour == shape_colour.
The target is the unique component passing the grown-by-2 corner test. Scenes where a target bracket passes are resampled.
The background is the strictly most common colour.
Each shape is 8-connected and spans its whole bounding box.
Requested frame counts are honoured exactly. Grid sizes are drawn only from those whose lattice capacity fits the request.
